hooks.name: Keep .kiro tracked and stay FOSS-only
hooks.description: On session start, remind the agent that .kiro stays committed and that dependencies stay free and open source.

action.prompt: STEP2Revit is free and open source. Keep the entire .kiro directory committed, and never gitignore .kiro or anything under it. Add only free and open-source libraries and free GitHub Actions. Do not add paid APIs, paid converters, or proprietary geometry kernels. The STEP parser stays cross-platform Python. The Revit family builder runs inside Revit on Windows and is not a paid web service. Follow the pipeline contract in .kiro/specs/step-to-rfa-pipeline/requirements.md.

hooks.name: Reject gitignore rules that drop .kiro
hooks.description: When .gitignore is saved, remind the agent to keep .kiro tracked.

action.prompt: A .gitignore file was saved. Confirm no rule ignores .kiro or any path under .kiro. Kiroween requires that tree to be committed. The Python template pattern *.spec matches filenames that end in .spec; it does not match the .kiro/specs directory. Keep the trailing !.kiro/ and !.kiro/** negations so .kiro stays tracked.
